subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be limited to documenting current pi-tui multiline shortcuts, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already supports multiline composition through the dependency, but a config or CLI preference would create a new public compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Document current behavior first
options.body: Update `docs/web/tui.md`, `docs/cli/tui.md`, and `/help` for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash fallback without adding a new config surface yet.

options.title: Add a supported keybinding preference
options.body: Define a TUI send/newline preference with schema or CLI ownership, docs, help text, and tests for default and configured behavior.

options.title: Close as covered by existing shortcuts
options.body: Treat pi-tui's current shortcuts as sufficient and leave configurable keybindings to a broader composer/editor decision.

recommendation.title: Document current behavior first
recommendation.body: Update `docs/web/tui.md`, `docs/cli/tui.md`, and `/help` for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash fallback without adding a new config surface yet.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest overlap with TUI docs, current editor/CLI history, and prior review context on the exact remaining decision.
